name: Evangelical Free Church of America

citations.locator: Evangelical Free Church of America, group profile
citations.excerpt: The Evangelical Free Church of America was founded in 1950 by the merger of two Scandinavian independent Pietistic associations of churches which had grown out of nineteenth-century revivals: the Swedish Evangelical Free Church and the Norwegian-Danish Evangelical Free Church Association.

facts.value: Formed in 1950 by merging the Swedish Evangelical Free Church and the Norwegian-Danish Evangelical Free Church Association, which grew from 19th-century Scandinavian revivals.
